generation.scope: Across all components, finite regular windows satisfying four-matrix identities at every corner are always center-finite composable domains of vertex index two or four. They are recognized by the octic central normalization test (path degree 30, quotient degree 29, Koszul degree 32) and the generic corner degree. The periodic-tail Ext incidence with a fixed thin simple cannot escape to infinity in a size-two character cone with disjoint vertex-extension directions, so all bad size-two orbits are finite up to scale. A regular PI algebra cannot have only finitely many grading orbits of simple modules.

open_mathematics: Remove the uniform four-corner hypothesis by studying single-corner matrix identities, and determine other finite components and their centers, periods and degenerations.
